records.action: Provide the legal seller name, business type/registration status and registration number if applicable. The brand/trading name is already confirmed.
Decide inspection, remedy selection and dispute procedure for wrong/damaged/faulty items; retain confirmed reporting and business-paid return delivery.
Provide the actual return destination, authorization and detailed instructions. Do not assume the business contact address is the return address.
Choose the COD refund method and inspection/outcome communication/dispute process; receipt and inspection before refund are already confirmed.
Specify refund processing duration and its start event.
Specify how a pre-dispatch cancellation is confirmed. Do not re-approve the confirmed cancellation rule.
Specify exchange processing time and treatment of a lower-priced replacement; retain the confirmed seven-day/condition/cost rules.
Supply appropriately reviewed mandatory consumer-rights wording and remedies; no blanket hygiene exclusion or waiver.
Specify order processing/dispatch time, working days and any cut-off.
Specify whether the confirmed 2–3-business-day estimate begins at confirmation or dispatch, and the weekend/holiday calendar.
Specify whether tracking is available and the actual customer communication channel; do not claim an unimplemented integration.
Specify customer notification/support procedure for courier delays.
Specify attempts, unavailable recipients, wrong addresses, redelivery/returned-parcel procedure and related charges.
Identify the responsible legal data controller using verified seller identity.
Operator verifies actual provider-account regions, access/transfers and service arrangements; owner approves the resulting disclosure. Do not infer regions from provider names.
Decide category-specific retention and deletion/backup/log treatment for accounts, orders, reviews and support.
Define access/correction/deletion requests, identity checks, responsible staff and response times. Support email is already confirmed.
Decide legal acceptance point and stock/price-error handling/customer notice.
Confirm tax status and whether prices include applicable taxes; approve pricing-error/price-change treatment. Do not invent tax obligations.
Decide COD collection confirmation, failed collection and eligibility rules. COD itself and pending PayHere status need no new approval.
Verify brand/website/image/supplier-content rights and approve use terms.
Obtain reviewed liability wording preserving mandatory consumer rights.
Define complaint acknowledgement, resolution/escalation and response time. Confirmed contacts/hours are unchanged.
Provide appropriately reviewed governing-law/dispute provisions.
Approve policy version/change notifications and actual effective/publication dates after final review.
Verify supplied contacts in the implementation and complete missing legal identity. Do not ask the owner to re-confirm existing contact facts or set this flag automatically.
Owner/legal review of all six completed pages and actual dates; set true only after genuine final approval.
Review genuine SKUs, variants, descriptions/claims, authorized relevant images, LKR prices/discounts and actual stock. No production catalog mutation is authorized.
Finish security/inventory/session/abuse controls and verify the reviewed deployed revisions/runtime settings. Passing local tests alone cannot approve this flag.
